summary: Chrome controls use React Aria input modality to paint focus rings. The drawer returns focus to its opening control without a ring after pointer dismissal, while keyboard focus keeps its ring.

replay.detail: The application does not replay graph data.

schema.detail: Storage and wire schemas do not change.

compatibility.detail: Chrome controls use the existing React Aria focus contract instead of an experimental browser focus option.

downtime.detail: The operator can reload the web application without service interruption.

manual.detail: The operator does not need an upgrade step.

recovery.detail: The operator can restore the previous web build without persistent state repair.
